protected_read_review.security_verdict: No verified ownership/security regression in reviewed fix
protected_read_review.bounded_retries: At most three attempts, only for a different current private regular inode after the old descriptor is proven unlinked. Bytes read from a replaced inode are discarded; an already-unlinked descriptor is not read.
protected_read_review.ownership: Every ancestor is descriptor-walked without following symlinks; root/current-UID ownership and nonwritable ancestry are checked, with only root-owned sticky ancestor exception. Leaf directory is current-UID private. File UID, private permissions, regular type and link count are checked before/after reads and against current path.
protected_read_review.fail_closed: Symlink, hardlink, foreign owner, permissive mode, FIFO/directory, in-place modification, parent replacement, missing path and exhausted replacement churn reject. STOP/expiry/current authority are rechecked after protected reads. No authorization fallback added.
protected_read_review.diagnostics: Only fixed role/stage/reason and inode ownership metadata are retained; no contents or arbitrary paths. Receiver preserves first protected-read failure alongside first STOP cause.
protected_read_review.historical_causality_limit: The017 failed frame proves protected_regular_owner_file_required with truncation. Its historical records lack failing pathname/fstat metadata; atomic replacement is independently reproducible but not retrospectively proven to be that frame's exact cause.
